reference: GNU coreutils 9.7 base64, run by system Bash on the reference side; stdout, status and stderr compared byte for byte.
coverage: Docker parity suite errors/base64: option and operand diagnostics.
exclusions: Only diagnostics are covered here; the reviewed suite in suites/ covers ordinary operation.

cases.purpose: Docker parity errors/base64: unknown options, a missing -w/--wrap argument, a rejected flag argument, quoted invalid wrap sizes, and an extra operand with the Try line; options after operands are still read first.
cases.script:
touch a b </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 --bogus </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 -@ </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 -w </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 --wrap </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 --decode=1 </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 -w x </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 -w -1 </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 -w '' </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 a b </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 a b --bogus </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
base64 nosuch </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"

cases.purpose: Wrap sizes GNU accepts: a leading sign or blank, leading zeros, an abbreviated --wrap, and a width too large for a signed index (no wrapping), and signed zero.
cases.script:
printf 'abcdefgh' | base64 -w +5 || echo "rc=$?"
printf 'abcdefgh' | base64 -w ' 4' || echo "rc=$?"
printf 'abcdefgh' | base64 -w 05 || echo "rc=$?"
printf 'abcdefgh' | base64 --wr=3 || echo "rc=$?"
printf 'abcdefgh' | base64 -w 99999999999999999999 || echo "rc=$?"
printf 'abcdefgh' | base64 -w -0 || echo "rc=$?"
base64 -w + </dev/null || echo "rc=$?"
